test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

How can you be so __joyless__ on hearing the news?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Blissful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"joyless"** means lacking joy or happiness; feeling or expressing no joy. (उदासीन)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt joyless after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **"Blissful" **refers to being extremely happy; full of joy. (आनंदमय)
 
 
• **Example: **The couple had a blissful honeymoon in the Maldives.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'joyless' **is **'blissful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Blissful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dubious **(संदेहपूर्ण): Hesitating or doubting.

 
 
• **Example:** He was dubious about the success of the new project.
 
 
 
• **Rapt **(मग्न): Completely fascinated by what one is seeing or hearing.
 
 
• **Example: **The audience was rapt during the entire performance.
 
 
 
• **Beaming** (मुस्कुराते हुए): Smiling broadly; grinning.
 
 
• **Example:** She was beaming with joy after winning the award.
 
 

4b:Tbd7,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.</p&
